title: rudgea hostmanniana subsp. maypurensis
intro: Rudgea hostmanniana subsp. maypurensis, commonly known as "Maypure tree", is a plant species from the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antipyretic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. These compounds have been shown to possess potential antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to the plant's therapeutic properties.
